description.en: QUAM Example A3: HCl titrated with NaOH that was itself standardised against KHP.
description.tr: QUAM Örnek A3: KHP'ye karşı ayarlanmış NaOH ile HCl titrasyonu.

explanation.en: c_HCl = 1000 · m_KHP · P_KHP · V_T2 / (V_T1 · M_KHP · V_HCl) · rep: V_T1 is the NaOH volume in the standardisation, V_T2 in the titration of 15 mL of HCl.
explanation.tr: c_HCl = 1000 · m_KHP · P_KHP · V_T2 / (V_T1 · M_KHP · V_HCl) · rep: V_T1 ayarlamadaki, V_T2 ise 15 mL HCl'nin titrasyonundaki NaOH hacmidir.

explanation.en: The repeatability of the whole two-step procedure is 0.1 % (rep), the largest single contribution.
explanation.tr: İki adımlı işlemin tamamının tekrarlanabilirliği %0,1'dir (rep); en büyük tekil katkı budur.

sources.document: EURACHEM/CITAC Guide CG 4, Quantifying Uncertainty in Analytical Measurement, 3rd ed. (QUAM:2012.P1)
sources.section: Example A3, Tables A3.2 and A3.3

notes.en: Finding: summary Table A3.1 states u_c = 0.00016 mol/L, but its own inputs give 0.00019 mol/L; 0.00016 is the result of the triple determination (Table A3.4).
notes.tr: Bulgu: Özet Tablo A3.1 u_c = 0,00016 mol/L verir, ancak kendi girdileri 0,00019 mol/L sonucunu verir; 0,00016 üçlü tayinin sonucudur (Tablo A3.4).

notes.en: The Kragten spreadsheet view (QUAM Appendix E.2), enabled in this project, reproduces the guide's printed spreadsheet value √3.34 × 10⁻⁸ mol/L to all printed digits; the exact first-order value differs only through the finite-difference approximation.
notes.tr: Bu projede etkin olan Kragten tablolama görünümü (QUAM Ek E.2), rehberin basılı tablolama değerini (√3,34 × 10⁻⁸ mol/L) basılı tüm basamaklarda yeniden üretir; kesin birinci mertebe değer yalnızca sonlu fark yaklaşımı nedeniyle farklıdır.

output.name: c_HCl
output.expression: 1000 * m_KHP * P_KHP * V_T2 / (V_T1 * M_KHP * V_HCl) * rep

description.en: NaOH volume for the HCl titration

reference.en: QUAM:2012 Table A3.3 (u_c = √3.34 × 10⁻⁸ mol/L) and result (0.1014 ± 0.0004) mol/L.
reference.tr: QUAM:2012 Tablo A3.3 (u_c = √3,34 × 10⁻⁸ mol/L) ve sonuç (0,1014 ± 0,0004) mol/L.
